output.question: Who is the parent company of Bath & Body Works?
output.answer: Bath & Body Works’ corporate parent is Bath & Body Works, Inc., a standalone publicly traded company—not a subsidiary of another corporate parent. It was formerly known as L Brands, Inc., which changed its name in August 2021 when the Victoria’s Secret business was separated.

key_facts.fact: Bath & Body Works, Inc. is identified as the parent company in its annual report dated March 12, 2026.
Bath & Body Works announced its status as a standalone public company following the separation of Victoria’s Secret.
L Brands, Inc. changed its corporate name to Bath & Body Works, Inc., effective August 2, 2021.
